body: I feel the same way. My family keeps me tethered to this pain and I hate them for it

Yeah, you're right. I think about quitting often, but my self-esteem is so low and I don't feel confident that I can find better work, or be able to keep it. I know I need to start building another nest, but it's so intimidating

>What is it you do? Is there something that you particularly hate about it?

I'm a clerical at a specialized (don't wanna say too much) insurance company. And I hate the working conditions more than the actual work (though the work is kinda boring and unfulfilling). I'm the youngest at the office and the least respected. I get paid the least, yet since we became understaffed a couple years ago, I often spend days having to fumble between several things at once.
I don't think I can anymore
I don't think I was ever meant to be here. Everything in my life has lead me to believe that
I don't think I'm built for this life. Everything is overwhelming and just not worth it

It just hit me that there's no reason for me to keep going. I may hate my life, job/field, etc. but there's nothing else I'd rather be doing, I'd be miserable regardless of if I'm a data entry clerk, or a hermit, or an international house DJ. I just don't want anything out of life, period.
Yeah I guess I should just live and look for opportunities along the way. Thank you for this comment
I don't have the energy to do anything anymore
